summary: Module 3 FIX: Trace to Missing Context. Step 1 -- violation stated precisely: deps.py:16 raises detail='missing bearer token', but errors.py:15 redact() pattern 'Bearer\s+[A-Za-z0-9\-._~+/]+=*' matched the literal words 'bearer token' and replaced them, so every 401 envelope rendered message='missing [REDACTED]' instead of 'missing bearer token' -- on BOTH existing /links and new /teams endpoints (confirmed with 15 live probes across compare_errors/compare_errors2/compare_401). Step 2 -- trace: the bug is in the codebase's own error-handling utility (errors.py redact), NOT in the agent's three outputs (they raise HTTPException correctly and are wrapped by main.py into error_envelope by construction). My M3 context package DID include errors.py and main.py as architectural/constraint context, which is why the agent's output matched -- so this was a codebase defect found BY the convention-matching drill, not a missing-context gap in my package. The missing context was inside errors.py itself: the bearer pattern needed a negative lookahead so the literal word 'token' is not mistaken for a token value. Step 3 -- added the context/fix: pattern changed to 'Bearer\s+(?!token\b)[A-Za-z0-9\-._~+/]+=*' so real JWTs still redact but 'missing bearer token' survives verbatim. Step 4 -- re-ran and verified: unit check_redact.py passes all 4 cases (message preserved, real bearer redacted, password redacted, plain message untouched); live verify_redact_live.py shows 401 'missing bearer token' and 'invalid or expired token' correctly; 75-test suite exits 0. Key lesson internalized: architectural context is not optional and must be accurate at the codebase level too -- a convention utility that itself mangles messages is a latent bug that no context package can paper over; the reviewer's job includes auditing the conventions the agent is told to match.
evidence: errors.py:15 pattern fixed with (?!token\b) negative lookahead
check_redact.py: 4/4 redaction cases pass (message preserved, tokens redacted)
verify_redact_live.py: 401 messages now correct ('missing bearer token', 'invalid or expired token')
